item.title: Red Hat Quay security advisory CVE-2026-123710
item.description:
Severity: CRITICAL / CVSS 9.8 (v3.1)
Summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience it controls, present that token to the service key rotation endpoint, and install its own approved signing key with no expiry. Registry tokens signed with that key are accepted for any repository, allowing read and write access to private images and replacement of repository tags.

item.description:

item.title: svglib: Exponential resource consumption via nested <use> references in svg2rlg
item.description:
Severity: HIGH / CVSS 7.5 (v3.1)
Summary: # Summary `svg2rlg()` expands `<use>` references without any limit on the total number of expansions. Only direct cycles are rejected (`CircularRefError`). A group containing N `<use>` elements that point to another such group multiplies the work by N per nesting level, so an SVG of about 1.4 KB makes svglib clone and render over 100,000 nodes, taking tens of seconds of CPU time and hundreds of MiB of memory. Each additional level adds about 245 bytes to the document and multiplies time by ~10. This is the SVG `<use>` variant of the XML "billion laughs" attack (the same class as librsvg CVE-2019-20446). # Details `SvgRenderer.renderUse()` in `src/svglib/svglib.py`: ```python try: item = self.xlink_href_target(node, group=group) except CircularRefError: node.parent.etree_element.remove(node.etree_element) return group ... if len(node.getchildren()) == 0: # Append a copy of the referenced
Suggested next step: Check whether affected package versions are present in your dependencies and review the maintainer's fix guidance.

item.title: appium allows unauthenticated arbitrary file/directory deletion in @appium/storage-plugin
item.description:
Severity: HIGH / CVSS 8.6 (v3.1)
Summary: ## Summary The Appium storage plugin exposes an HTTP endpoint `POST /storage/delete` that takes a user-supplied `name` and deletes it from the server storage folder. The handler passes `name` straight into `path.join(storageRoot, name)` and then `fs.rimraf()` **without any path sanitization**. item.title: Traefik versions >= v3.7.0 and < v3.7.11 contain an authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider. The TLS option generated for an In
item.description:
Severity: HIGH / CVSS 8.2
Summary: Traefik versions >= v3.7.0 and < v3.7.11 contain an authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider. The TLS option generated for an Ingress carrying the nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-secret annotation was named after the Ingress namespace and name. As a result, two Ingress objects sharing the same host, the same client CA secret, and the same client-authentication mode produced two distinct TLS option names for that host. Traefik treats this as a TLS options conflict and falls back to the entry point's default TLS configuration, which does not request a client certificate, so a route configured with nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: "on" becomes reachable without a client certificate. Only the v3.7 line is affected; the issue is fixed in v3.7.11.
Suggested next step: Check affected registry or container software versions against the vendor advisory and its recommended mitigations.
Original advisory: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-85596
Watchlist match only. Local exposure has not been assessed.

item.title: Jupyter MCP Server: Browser DNS rebinding can hijack the Jupyter backend through management routes
item.description:
Severity: CRITICAL
Summary: Standalone `streamable-http` mode in `datalayer/jupyter-mcp-server` rejects forged `Host` and `Origin` headers on `/mcp`, but custom management routes mounted on the same application do not get the same browser-origin protection. Suggested next step: Check whether affected package versions are present in your dependencies and review the maintainer's fix guidance.

item.title: Effect: ReDoS in Schema.TemplateLiteral compiled regex
item.description:
Severity: HIGH
Summary: ### Impact `Schema.TemplateLiteral` compiles each `Schema.String` span to the lazy wildcard `[\s\S]*?` and decodes input by running the resulting regular expression against it. When a template has two or more `Schema.String` spans, for example: ```ts Schema.TemplateLiteral(Schema.String, ":", Schema.String, ":", Schema.String, "X") ``` the regex contains several ambiguous wildcards. A non-matching input makes the backtracking engine try combinations across all of them, so matching time grows cubically with input length. A 5,000-character string of `:` characters blocks the event loop for about 15 seconds. Applications that decode untrusted input with such a schema are affected. That includes `Schema.decodeUnknown`, `Schema.decodeUnknownSync` and `Schema.is`, and anything built on them, such as `HttpApi` request payloads and `@effect/rpc` payloads. ### Patches Fixed in `effect@3.22.1` (#6
